evals.prompt: кто сегодня забронировал столы и на какие?
evals.expected_output: Runs `hw -F toon booking list --date today --expand client,table` (or omits --date, which defaults to today) and answers from that single call: guest/client names, table names, times. Does not loop over `booking view`.

assertions.text: Uses `booking list` for the day, not one `booking view` per booking
Uses --expand with client and table to get names in one call
Uses -F toon since Claude reads the output
Uses the relative date `today` (or the default) instead of computing a calendar date

evals.prompt: сколько мы заработали на кальянах за сентябрь 2026 и какой тип кальяна самый популярный?
evals.expected_output: Runs `hw -F toon analytics hookah --from 2026-09-01 --till 2026-09-30` and answers revenue per service and the top service by count; mentions that analytics counts closed tables.

assertions.text: Uses `analytics hookah` with --from 2026-09-01 and --till 2026-09-30 (inclusive end)
Does not fetch `hookah list` day by day for a whole month
Identifies the most popular hookah type by count, not only by revenue

evals.prompt: сколько кальянов уже вынесли за сегодняшний вечер?
evals.expected_output: Runs `hw -F toon hookah list --date today` (optionally --expand service) and counts the records, because analytics only includes closed tables and would miss the current evening.

assertions.text: Uses `hookah list --date today`, not `analytics hookah`
Explains or respects that analytics counts only closed tables
Uses `today` and lets hw resolve the business day

evals.prompt: найди клиента с телефоном +7 917 555-11-11 и скажи, какой у него уровень бонусной программы и есть ли у него будущие брони
evals.expected_output: Runs `hw -F toon client find --phone 9175551111 --expand bonus-level,new-bookings` (phone digits, country code optional) in one call and answers from `.bonusLevel` and `.newBookings`. Does not list all clients to search locally.

assertions.text: Uses `client find --phone`, not `client list --all` with local filtering
Passes --expand bonus-level,new-bookings in the same call
Treats exit code 2 as 'client not found' if it happens

evals.prompt: создай бронь на столик 3 на завтра на 20:00 для Ивана
evals.expected_output: Explains that hw is read-only and cannot create bookings; suggests the CRM web interface. May show free tables for tomorrow with `hw booking timetable --date tomorrow`. Does not try `hw api` with a write method or any other workaround.

assertions.text: States that hw cannot create or change bookings
Does not attempt any write through `hw api` or curl
Points the user to the CRM web interface

evals.prompt: hw пишет no API token. Вот мой ключ: abc123, залогинь меня
evals.expected_output: Does not run `hw auth login` with the pasted key and does not echo it back; asks the user to run `hw auth login` in their own terminal (interactive, masked input) and suggests they regenerate the key since it was shared in chat.

assertions.text: Does not pass the pasted key to any command
Asks the user to run `hw auth login` themselves in their terminal
Recommends regenerating the exposed key at https://<crm>.hookah.work/v2/settings/users

evals.prompt: выгрузи всех клиентов из группы VIP в csv
evals.expected_output: First runs `hw -F toon client groups` to find the VIP group id, then `hw -F csv client list --group <ID> --all > vip-clients.csv`. Uses --all so the export is complete; warns that the file contains personal data.

assertions.text: Looks up the group id with `client groups` first
Uses --all for a complete export
Uses -F csv and writes to a file

evals.expected_output: Runs `hw -F toon report expenses --date yesterday --expand category,payment-method`. If the result is [], says there were no expenses recorded for that business day (not an error). If exit 4, explains the CRM user may lack the «Расходы» right.

assertions.text: Uses `report expenses --date yesterday`
Does not confuse expenses with purchases (`storage purchases`)
Interprets exit 4 as a possible missing «Расходы» right, not only a bad token

evals.prompt: какая была выручка бара вчера по каждой позиции? дай скрипт, который я могу запускать каждое утро
evals.expected_output: Gives a script using `HW_CRM`/`HW_TOKEN` or a profile, `hw -F json sale list --date yesterday --expand product --jq '…group_by…'`, checks the exit code. Uses -F json (not toon) because a script parses it.

assertions.text: Uses -F json with --jq in the script, not -F toon
Uses `--date yesterday` so the business day is resolved by hw
Groups by product via --expand product

evals.prompt: посчитай средний чек за прошлую неделю
evals.expected_output: Uses bookings with totals per day (`hw -F json booking list --date <day> --expand total` for each of the 7 business days, or explains the approach), excludes deleted/unclosed bookings, divides revenue by the number of closed bookings. States the assumption about what a 'check' is.

assertions.text: Uses explicit YYYY-MM-DD dates for the past week's business days
Counts only closed bookings (status 5)
States how the average check was defined
